name: Carrying a Qin on a Visit
material: hanging scroll (now paneled); ink on silk
summary: Carrying a Qin on a Visit (攜琴訪友圖), 1271–1368. Attributed to Luo Zhichuan (Chinese, active 1280s–1320s). Hanging scroll (now paneled); ink on silk; painting: 81.4 x 35.3 cm (32 1/16 x 13 7/8 in.); overall: 170.5 x 49.1 cm (67 1/8 x 19 5/16 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, General Income Fund, 1919.
